source: NOAA RTSW + WSA cache + DONKI cache
description: Self-tuning solar wind model. Background wind is persistence + 27-day recurrence + WSA. CME-enhanced wind adds Earth-directed DONKI CME pulses. NOAA observed solar wind verifies and slowly updates coefficients.

notes: Enhanced = background + Earth-directed DONKI CME pulse.
NOAA RTSW observed solar wind is used for verification and coefficient tuning.
